headline: Radio Telescope Captures Strange Signal From Deep Space
dispatch: Astronomers at Ohio State University's Big Ear radio telescope recorded an unusually powerful narrowband signal late Thursday night that has no known terrestrial explanation. The signal lasted 72 seconds and bore the hallmarks researchers associate with a possible extraterrestrial transmission. Staff are reviewing the data and urge caution, noting that no follow-up signal has yet been detected.
answer: Big Ear telescope receives the Wow! signal, 1977
